name: Recycling
highLevelGoals: To enable users to easily find nearby recycling facilities, view their operational details, and access location maps for efficient waste disposal.
To allow users to create and manage their accounts, personalize their experience, and receive relevant notifications.
To provide users with tools to schedule and plan their recycling activities, including flexible pickup options and recommendations based on their availability and waste types.
To offer users a channel to communicate with administrators, provide feedback, and seek assistance regarding the application or recycling services.
To incentivize user engagement by providing a system for users to earn and receive rewards for their recycling activities.
To ensure that all recycling facility information displayed on the platform is current, accurate, and comprehensive for users.
To enable administrators to review user feedback and complaints, communicate with facilities, and continuously improve the service based on user input.
To empower facility representatives to directly manage and update their facility's details, including accepted materials and operational hours, to ensure accuracy.
To provide a direct communication channel for facility representatives to convey issues or concerns to site administrators for resolution.
To allow superusers to update recycling center information, ensuring the platform provides the latest and most accurate details to users.
To enable superusers to directly answer user questions related to recycling centers, providing timely and accurate support.
lowLevelGoals: The system shall allow the user to retrieve a list of recycling facilities within a specified radius of their current location.
The system shall allow the user to view detailed information for a selected recycling facility, including accepted materials, operating hours, and contact information.
The system shall display the selected recycling facility's location on an interactive map.
The system shall allow the user to open the selected recycling facility's location in an external mapping application (e.g., Google Maps).
The system shall allow the user to filter the list of recycling facilities by specific material types they wish to recycle.
The system shall allow the user to filter the list of recycling facilities by their environment-friendly status.
The system shall display the locations of public recycling bins on an interactive map.
The system shall display the locations of special waste drop-off sites on an interactive map.
The system shall allow the user to view a list of upcoming safe disposal events, including dates, times, and locations.
The system shall allow the user to mark a recycling facility as a favorite for quick access.
The system shall allow the user to create a new user account by providing a unique email and password.
The system shall allow the user to update their personal information, such as name, address, and contact details.
The system shall allow the user to link their email address to their profile for password recovery purposes.
The system shall allow the user to set their preferred recycling material types and notification preferences.
The system shall send push notifications to the user based on their set preferences, such as nearby facility updates or recycling reminders.
The system shall allow the user to schedule a drop-off time at a selected recycling facility.
The system shall allow the user to upload or sync their weekly schedule to receive personalized recycling recommendations.
The system shall provide recommendations to the user for optimal recycling methods or facilities based on their waste types and availability.
The system shall allow the user to submit feedback or suggestions regarding the application or recycling services.
The system shall allow the user to submit a support request for assistance with application issues or general inquiries.
The system shall allow the user to view the status and responses for their submitted support requests.
The system shall allow the user to access help articles and documentation for using the application.
The system shall automatically award reward points to the user upon completion of a verified recycling activity.
The system shall allow the user to view their current reward point balance.
The system shall allow the user to redeem their accumulated reward points for available incentives.
The system shall allow the administrator to add new recycling facility information, including name, address, and contact details.
The system shall allow the administrator to edit existing recycling facility details, such as operating hours, accepted materials, and services.
The system shall allow the administrator to remove outdated or incorrect recycling facility entries.
The system shall allow the administrator to review and approve updates submitted by facility representatives.
The system shall allow the administrator to view a consolidated list of all user feedback and complaints.
The system shall allow the administrator to respond directly to user feedback or support requests.
The system shall allow the administrator to forward specific user feedback or complaints to the relevant facility representative.
The system shall allow the facility representative to update their facility's operating hours.
The system shall allow the facility representative to update the list of accepted recycling materials at their facility.
The system shall allow the facility representative to update their facility's contact information.
The system shall allow the facility representative to submit their updated facility information for administrator approval.
The system shall allow the facility representative to send a report of an issue or concern directly to site administrators.
The system shall allow the facility representative to receive responses from site administrators regarding their reported issues.
The system shall allow the superuser to update any information related to recycling centers, including those not directly managed by facility representatives.
The system shall allow the superuser to add new recycling centers to the platform.
The system shall allow the superuser to delete recycling center entries from the platform.
The system shall allow the superuser to view all user questions and inquiries related to recycling centers.
The system shall allow the superuser to directly reply to a user's question regarding recycling centers.
The system shall allow the superuser to mark a user inquiry as resolved after providing a response.
